figures.finding: Algeria's National Fund for the Development of Cinematographic Technique and Industry (special account 302-157, opened under the 2025 finance law) funds production, co-production, post-production, script writing, distribution and exploitation through the culture ministry's bodies; public aid is awarded by a commission under Executive Decree 25-314, the producer contributing at least 30% of the film's budget, and the ministry may co-produce with any share.

law: Loi n° 24-07 du 29 avril 2024 relative à l'industrie cinématographique
